title: BI Developer (Power BI)
summary: A BI developer builds the reports and dashboards that business teams use to track numbers, most often in Power BI. They sit between the data or IT team and business users, turning raw data from databases into clean data models and clear reports.
dailyDuties: Meet business users to turn their questions into report requirements and KPIs
Write SQL against source databases and the data warehouse
Shape and combine source data in Power Query
Design star-schema data models with clean relationships
Build Power BI reports with DAX measures and publish them to the service
Schedule data refreshes and fix slow queries and refreshes
Walk users through reports and explain the numbers

skills.expectation: Build Power BI reports with DAX measures and publish them to the service
Shape and combine source data in Power Query
Design star-schema semantic models with clean relationships
Write SQL against the source databases
Load and refresh data from several sources on a schedule
Design clear dashboards for business users
Turn business questions into report requirements and KPIs
Explain numbers and walk users through reports
Report from Snowflake, Synapse or a similar warehouse
Use Azure data services such as Data Factory or Fabric
Use window functions and CTEs for complex logic
Speed up slow queries and refreshes
Hand off data in Excel when users need it
Maintain reports in a second BI tool

certifications.why: Basic Azure for BI work on Azure data services
